_comment: Benchmark registry for the eval-checkpoints skill. This is the only place
benchmark names appear in the skill's code, so adding one is a data edit.
instances: size of the scored split, used for cost estimation.
choices:   vLLM prompts issued per instance. MCQ log-likelihood scoring sends
one prompt per answer choice; generative tasks send one per
instance, so choices is 1 for them.
split:     which split the olmo-eval task scores. Documented here so the
estimate can be checked against the task definition.
metrics:   metric keys the task emits in metrics.json. Tasks with more than
one get qualified column names in accuracy_wide.csv.
aliases:   common wrong names, mapped to the real olmo-eval task name. Used
only to produce a helpful error; they are never runnable.
See BENCHMARKS.md for where these numbers come from and why these splits.

limit_unsafe.hellaswag: loads validation AND train when limited, then samples from the union
limit_unsafe.socialiqa: loads validation AND train when limited, then samples from the union
